method: WebGL2 RGBA8 offscreen 1280x720, same four native scenes/uniforms, 24 interactions. Three alternating-order blocks per scene/variant; five warmup and ten measured completed frames. Every draw has a separate EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 elapsed query and synchronous 1-pixel readback before the next draw. Disjoint samples reject the run. GPU elapsed and draw-plus-readback wall times reported separately. Compilation, warmup, timer-result polling, full-image readback, Playwright IPC, UI and vsync excluded. Per-frame completion prevents elimination of earlier identical fullscreen draws.
